usedFor: Raisely holds your donors and MailChimp holds your audience, so “New Online Donation” runs “Update Subscriber”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Online Donation” in Raisely, then “Update Subscriber” in MailChimp
bestTemplate.why: A donation updates the donor's subscriber profile, so your next email reflects it.

watchOut: “Add Tags to Audience Member” finds people by email, and “New Campaign” carries no donor email to tag.
